prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide three-panel editorial story banner for the README of Baby Signal, an open-source accessible iPhone baby-cry reminder prototype for deaf and hard-of-hearing caregivers. Primary request: convey why turning an auditory baby cry into a tactile wrist reminder matters, with a respectful fictional parent and no identifiable real people. Panel one: a capable Chinese mother in warm peach clothing quietly watching her infant resting on its back on a bare firm mattress in a crib, conveying sustained attention rather than helplessness. Panel two: a smartphone upright on a separate table well outside the crib and a close view of the mother's smartwatch with a simple bell icon and restrained vibration arcs. Panel three: the mother attentively holding her awake baby with the head and neck well supported. Use the same fictional mother across panels. Warm cream, clay terracotta and muted sage palette, adult-friendly hand-painted editorial illustration with clear simple forms, calm caring mood and light paper texture. Wide horizontal composition with three clearly separated scenes and generous margins. No text, no letters, no numbers, no app brands, no social network interface, no chat screenshot, no hospital or medical equipment, no illness narrative, no poverty stereotypes, no hearing aids as a disability shorthand, no invented sign language, no watermarks. No pillows, blankets, soft toys or loose bedding in the crib. No phone or cables inside the crib or within reach of baby. Illustration communicates a product concept, not proven reliable monitoring or guaranteed safety.
